CBSE clarifies three-language policy for classes 6-9

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has issued clarifications regarding its three-language policy. The policy will now be implemented for students from Class 6 onwards, with no mid-way changes for those in Classes 7, 8, and 9. Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan announced the relaxation, which aims to provide flexibility in language choices for students.
